text: {"reasons": [{"area": "money", "reason": "A parent reports that some games on Roblox contain optional in-game purchases like lootboxes where rewards are unknown, which experts say can encourage repeated spending."}, {"area": "age_gating", "reason": "A review states that Roblox’s age check requires showing your face via camera and using AI to estimate age, and if incorrect, demands ID submission, with a partner company retaining and selling photos; a news source notes kids can bypass checks by entering any birthdate before September 2007."}, {"area": "developer_record", "reason": "A news article reports Los Angeles County filed a civil lawsuit alleging Roblox falsely marketed its platform as safe for children while knowingly allowing it to become a hunting ground for predators."}]}
